cases.name: Rochelle S. Anderson
cases.about: She worked at the Zephyr Fuel and Convenience Store. Her obituary said, "She was a 2001 Graduate of Tomahawk High School. She had previously been employed at River Valley State Bank in Tomahawk and most recently at the Zephyr Gas Station in Tomahawk. Rochelle enjoyed spending time with family and friends but most of all she loved being a mom."
